text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There is but one answer to your woes,
and that is
to become more
marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
More marvelous? Uh... What do you
mean by—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
By marveling at marvels, of course! The
fact that
we were born... The fact that
we crossed paths...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why, they're all fabulous miracles!
Destiny!
Statistically marvelous marvels!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You've been marvelous since you were
born! ☆
And the fact that you're here in
this moment is
equally marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I see! Destiny and miracles... They're
both
marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I think I feel a bit better now!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Nice! Oh, you there, do you have
something
weighing on your mind too?
Well, come on over!
I'm all ears! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday looks at me with
shining,
expectant eyes... Well, I might
as well ask for her
advice while I'm here.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I see! That's okay! The fact that you've noticed how tired you are is really great! It's marvelous even! ☆
choice_data_list: もっとやる気を出したいんだ

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If you continue to believe in yourself,
then you'll
be filled with marvelous
power one day!
Ahahaha! ☆ Ahahaha! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I see! That's okay! The fact that you want to want to be more motivated is really great! It's marvelous even! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If you keep doing what you're doing, I'm
sure
you'll naturally find the motivation
one day!
Ahahaha! ☆ Ahahaha! ★
